actions.description: Move the stage to an absolute X/Y position (and R when given) and wait, bounded by the request deadline, until the controller reports no axis moving; the position it reports is returned

actions.description: Stop all motion on the resource with a declared deceleration profile and report the stopping position. This capability is always cancellable=false and is exempt from rate limiting.

inputs.description: Optional class field; the native stop has no deceleration parameter, so the controller's configured stop mode is used and this value is not applied

actions.name: stop_motion

facts.text: The ZC300 XYR stage is driven over Modbus RTU at 115200 8N1 with function codes 0x03/0x04 for reads, 0x06 for single-register writes and 0x10 only for the opcode block (three registers for a move, two for a stop)
Position X, Y and R is in registers 30016-30021 as IEEE-754 float32 big-endian pairs, and the status register 30012-30015 has bit 9 as the emergency stop
The opcode block is 30050: 0x0064 absolute, 0x0065 fixed-length, 0x0066 continuous, 0x0067 decel stop, 0x0068 immediate stop and 0x0069 home; axis 0x31 X, 0x32 Y, 0x33 R
The documented scale is 0.625 micrometres per pulse in X and Y and 0.00125 degrees per pulse in R
The absolute-move opcode silently does nothing on the real controller, so every absolute move is composed from fixed-length moves and each distance register is read back before the motion opcode
move_abs_um computes the relative delta from get_position and calls move_rel_um, which rounds the deltas to pulses with the configured scale

stop() sends the configured stop opcode to AXIS_ALL, waits with _wait_stopped(0.3), and when that returns False sends the immediate stop and waits with _wait_stopped(0.2); it catches and logs every exception and never raises
_wait_stopped returns True once no axis reports moving and also when a status read raises, and False when its timeout passes

get_status reads 10 input registers from 30012 and returns a moving flag per axis (motion word equal to 1), the X and Y limit bits, the three home bits, the estop bit and an alarm flag set when any axis alarm bit is set
The status word assigns limit bits 0, 1, 3, 4, 6 and 7, home bits 2, 5 and 8, the emergency-stop bit 9 and the axis alarm bits 10, 11 and 12
get_position reads six input registers from 30016 and converts pulses to micrometres and degrees with the configured scale
The constructor creates the driver's lock as a threading.RLock
move_rel_um holds the lock while it calls _ensure_not_moving and then, axis by axis, calls _ensure_speed, writes the distance, reads it back and writes the fixed-length opcode
connect() opens the port at 115200 8N1, reads the motion-state and model registers, and for each axis of _axes_here() writes 0x01 to its enable register and accel_pps2 to its acceleration register
The constructor defaults include port COM3, slave_address 1, slow_speed_pps 500, fast_speed_pps 2000, accel_pps2 10_000_000 and stop_mode immediate
TALOS is a desktop application that owns an entire 2D-material transfer bench: the camera, the XYR sample stage, the XYZ transfer stage, the focus axis and the hot stage
The README warns that controllers can forget their position on power-cycle and says to treat stored coordinates as session-relative and re-establish references after a reset
